verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say you can charge customers in over 135 currencies and receive funds in your preferred currency. Payment Links let customers pay in their local currency, and payouts send funds to your bank account. Nothing in the pack covers how FX conversion is handled or disclosed, so the 'transparent FX handling' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of FX rates, conversion fees and their disclosure, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-currency settlement.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: You can charge customers in over 135 currencies and receive funds in your preferred currency.
Let your customers use a link to pay in their local language and currency with their preferred payment method.
Stripe sends funds from your available balance to your bank account as payouts
